{{Quote|Nothing! The archive is empty! Just a bunch of useless scrolls and tablets! Where is the holocron? Tell me, or I'll skin you alive!|Malefax interrogates Hethan Romund|<ref name="Mountaintop Rescue" />}}
'''Malefax''' was a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. He carried [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and an ancient [[Sith sword]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he fell under the sway of the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Rav Naaran/Legends|Rav Naaran]], who was held in [[Prison|stasis]] at the [[Dawn Temple]]. Malefax then kidnapped the scholar [[Hethan Romund]] and brought her to the temple on [[Mount Tellec/Legends|Mount Tellec]] at [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]] along with [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. Romund was able to get a message off to some of her students, who came to Spintir to rescue her. They infiltrated the Temple and dueled Malefax, but only after he was able to sabotage part of the Dawn Temple.

==Biography==
{{Quote|My temple is currently occupied by a servant of the dark side of the Force. I wish this villain removed, before his corruption of this sacred valley becomes permanent.|The Curator|<ref name="Mountaintop Rescue" />}}
Malefax abducted [[Hethan Romund]] to gain access to the secrets of [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]'s [[Dawn Temple]].<ref name="Mountaintop Rescue" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He is completely ensnared by the dark side, and utterly focused on increasing his own power. He will underestimate you, and particularly underestimate your ability to work as a team.|The Curator, describing Malefax|<ref name="Mountaintop Rescue" />}}
Malefax was corrupted by the dark side.<ref name="Mountaintop Rescue" />

{{Char-stub}}
